narr: A typical summertime pattern prevailed with scattered afternoon thunderstorms across the tri-state region. A few storms produced damaging wind gusts with impacts to trees and power lines along with heavy rain which resulted in localized flooding.
ev: Salem Church Road at Gemini Loop was closed due to flooding.
Highway 69 between Stephens Road and Hamilton Road was closed due to flooding.
A car was swept off the road near Lincoln Dr and Congo Rd.
